gaps.needs: Perfectness of the Galois-equivariant Grothendieck pairing on geometric component groups of an arbitrary abelian variety and its dual over a nonarchimedean local field with finite residue field, without semistability.

For a definable family Z⊆ℝⁿ×ℝᵐ in an o-minimal expansion of the real field and ε>0, finitely many basic block families (Pila 2009, Definition 3.2) with fibres contained in the fibres of Z and a constant c>0 such that, for every parameter t and every T≥1, the rational points of Z_t of height at most T lie in at most c·T^ε of their fibres (Pila 2009, Theorem 3.5).

For a smooth complex algebraic variety S, a closed complex analytic E⊆S^an and a closed complex analytic A⊆S^an∖E definable in an o-minimal expansion of R_an, the closure of A in S^an is complex analytic (Peterzil–Starchenko, Theorem 4.4).
